upcoming.note: Since Genesis ended (Oct 2025) Virtuals has no pledge window: launches open trading immediately on a bonding curve. "Upcoming" = projects with a future launch time (Launch Radar or scheduled) and live 60-Days trials. Anticipation score adds observable signals only (radar, Virtuals verification, verified links, listed team, GitHub pushes, news mentions, pre-launch holders).

genesis.caveats: Pledges above the reserve target were refunded, so "pledged / 42,000" is a demand multiple, not the allocation odds; per-launch reserve tier (21k/42k/100k VIRTUAL) and launch FDV are not exposed by the API, so entry-price returns cannot be computed honestly here. Current mcap uses the Virtuals API value x VIRTUAL/USD.

mechanics.headline: There is no pledge or points allocation any more. Genesis (Virgen points + VIRTUAL pledges) ran Apr-Oct 2025 and was sunset; Virgen points were phased out. In 2026 every Virtuals launch opens trading immediately on a public bonding curve: no presale, whitelist or allocation cap.

ways_to_get_in.what: Buy on the bonding curve at launch
ways_to_get_in.how: Trade on app.virtuals.io the moment trading opens. If the founder enabled Anti-Sniper Protection, buys pay a tax that starts at 99% and decays to 1% over 0 s / 60 s / 10 min / 98 min (founder choice); tax proceeds buy back the token for the team (3-month cliff, 9-month vesting). Buying in the first minutes of a 98-minute window can cost most of your money in tax.

Lock VIRTUAL for up to 2 years; veVIRTUAL decays linearly to 0 at unlock (Auto Max-Lock keeps the full 2-year weight). Launches that turn on the Airdrop Distribution module give up to 5% of supply (50M tokens) to stakers pro-rata to veVIRTUAL.
ways_to_get_in.caps: pro-rata, only launches with the module on

ways_to_get_in.how: Deposit USDC into the pool at a fixed FDV set by the founder (up to 5% of the team allocation). Oversubscribed pools are pro-rated and unused USDC is refunded. Tokens vest linearly over 6 months if the founder commits.
ways_to_get_in.caps: pool size set by founder; pro-rata
ways_to_get_in.refund: full refund if the founder does not commit by day 60

ways_to_get_in.how: If a 60 Days founder walks away, the LP is drained and released ACF funds + the founder's 70% fee share + remaining VIRTUAL in the LP go back to eligible holders pro-rata (public-launch buys and airdrops; pre-buy only shares the LP part). Refunds are not guaranteed to be full.
Every token graduating after 2026-07-27 releases a reserved reward pool over 14 days: 1/14 per day, split between traders (pro-rata to daily volume) and content about the token.
Founders pay 100 VIRTUAL to list a project before trading opens. It gives visibility only: no reserved allocation.

mechanics.fees: 1% trading fee from day one: 70% to the creator (locked during a 60 Days trial), 30% to the Virtuals treasury. Graduation at 42,000 VIRTUAL into a Uniswap V2 pool with a 10-year LP lock.
mechanics.titan: Titan launches (established teams) need >= ~$50M valuation and >= $500K USDC-equivalent VIRTUAL liquidity at TGE; first one was Fabric Foundation (Feb 2026).

protocols.method: Objective score = weighted percentile ranks inside this peer group: 30d fees/revenue (30%), market cap (25%), 30d price change (20%), GitHub commits in 30d (15%), volume/mcap turnover (10%); missing inputs are skipped. Desk score = objective x (1 + 0.25 x (thesis weight - 1)); Virtuals has thesis weight 2.0 (user thesis), so it is lifted 25%. Both ranks are shown so the tilt is visible.

crossref.note: Pump-detector rows come from data/live_feed.json (same grades as the Crypto desk); it only scans tokens it has seen, so most Virtuals curve tokens have no grade. Early-launch pattern = <24 h old or still on the bonding curve.

burns.method: daily archive reads of totalSupply() and balances of 0x…dead and 0x0 (Base); a burn day is any day those show >1 DOT destroyed
